title: Agentic LLM Workflows for Generating Patient-Friendly Medical Reports

prompt.location: Sec 2 (overall_score formula given exactly: readability*0.3 + accuracy*0.7); exact system/user prompt text not quoted (footnote: "LLM prompts have been programmed and cannot be altered by users")

notes: Accuracy is measured deterministically (generated ICD-10 codes checked against a code database via string matching, simple_icd_10 package), so no LLM-judge dependency. Soft gaps: the exact prompt text is not printed, and the radiology-report source/dataset is not identified as public.
